# mimecast_dns_authentication_outbound_definition (Resource)

Manage a Mimecast DNS authentication outbound definition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_dns_authentication_outbound_definition" "example" {
  description = "tf-example-dkim"
  domain      = "example.com"
  selector    = "mimecast"
  sign_dkim   = true
  key_length  = 2048
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Definition description.
- `domain` (String) Domain associated with the definition.

### Optional

- `key_length` (Number) DKIM public key length, typically 1024 or 2048.
- `selector` (String) DKIM selector. Mimecast applies a default when omitted.
- `sign_dkim` (Boolean) Whether to sign outbound messages with DKIM.

### Read-Only

- `dns_address` (String) DNS address returned by Mimecast.
- `id` (String) Mimecast DNS authentication outbound definition ID.
- `public_key` (String) DKIM public key returned by Mimecast.
- `validated` (Boolean) Whether the definition has been validated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_dns_authentication_outbound_definition.example definition-id
```
